title: HBV-Lab: an agentic HBV hydrological model with an MCP server
description: An object-oriented Python implementation of the lumped conceptual HBV rainfall-runoff model, with calibration (Nelder-Mead, Powell or DDS), Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents set up, calibrate and diagnose the model. Version 1.5.1 adds store levels to the run_model reply, documents initial conditions in the MCP tools, and pins mcp<2 for the MCP extra.
